title: Private jet charter to South Korea: permits and rules
description: Private flights to South Korea: charter and private flight permits from MOLIT, the time window, overflight and airports, from official Korean sources.
h1: Private flights to and from South Korea
lead: Every private or charter flight to South Korea needs the authority's permission first. What the rules are, how far ahead to plan, and what they mean for your trip.

sections.h: Permits for charter and private flights
p: The authority is the {{kr.authority}}. For a charter: {{kr.permit}}. For a private flight: {{kr.permit_private}}.
A permit is tied to its time: {{kr.notable}}. When plans move, we ask the operator to update the permit before the window closes.
Crossing Korean airspace: {{kr.overflight}}. Landing: {{kr.customs_airports}}. Our Seoul guide compares Gimpo, close to the city with a night closure, and Incheon, open around the clock.

The operator that flies your trip applies, usually through its handling agent or a flight-permit service. You do not need to deal with the authority yourself. What you can do is give us final names, passport details and times early, because a permit is issued for a given aircraft, schedule and passenger list, and late changes can mean a new application.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from South Korea
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator against our safety standard before you see a quote, and ask the operator to apply for the permits early, because the authority's answer decides the schedule. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.
Permit rules change. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its official source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: What happens if my flight to Seoul is delayed?
faq.a: The permit has a time window: {{kr.notable}}. The operator applies again if the new time falls outside it.

faq.q: Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
